items.title: Peter Ecklund interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 14, 1998
items.q: trumpet players who are like spending their lives sitting on the bus in Stan Kenton’s orchestra just never get exposed to

ctx.x: I played in his band for about six years. That’s really I think what makes me different from a lot of other musicians is I had that experience, like just music like that which is basically a mixture of many kinds of American music. It was basically a band that played traditional music of many different kinds, kind of gussied up with a rock rhythm section. And David is a very good showman so it’s a band that I think the records were never quite as good as the shows, but that was a really great experience. I…
But you have done some big band playing?
